title: pyrus atlantica
intro: Pyrus atlantica, commonly known as the Atlas apricot or Moroccan apricot, is a species of apricot tree native to the Atlas Mountains in North Africa. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Pyrus atlantica include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus atlantica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing oxidative stress and modulating the immune system.
